subject.title: refactor(retry): add full-jitter mode and adopt it for mattermost client retries

question: Should the injectable `random` source become permanent public `RetryOptions` API, or should deterministic randomness remain internal while only `jitter: "full"` is exposed?
rationale: The runtime migration is bounded and coherent, but the shipped plugin SDK currently exports `RetryOptions`; repository policy requires maintainer intent before accepting a new permanent plugin contract that is primarily motivated by deterministic tests.

options.title: Keep random internal
options.body: Expose full-jitter as the shared strategy but test it through an internal deterministic-random seam so plugins do not gain an unnecessary option.

options.title: Approve both options
options.body: Accept `jitter: "full"` and `random` as intentional additive public plugin SDK contracts.

options.title: Retain local retry
options.body: Keep the current Mattermost-owned loop until maintainers approve a broader shared retry API.

recommendation.title: Keep random internal
recommendation.body: Expose full-jitter as the shared strategy but test it through an internal deterministic-random seam so plugins do not gain an unnecessary option.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared retry API and Mattermost retry behavior both trace to Vincent Koc's implementation commit, making this the strongest available contract-owner signal.
